content.text:
Validation complete. SVA Studio is installed and operational for the local-builder profile in /workspace.

EVIDENCE OF OPERATIONAL STATE (all commands from /workspace):
- `pnpm check:toolchain-consistency` → exit 0 (Node v24.15.0, pnpm 11.3.0 match .nvmrc/packageManager)
- `docker ps`: sva-studio-postgres (postgres:16-alpine) + workspace-redis-1 (redis:7-alpine) both Up (healthy); `pg_isready` OK, `redis-cli ping` → PONG; TLS certs present in dev/redis-tls/
- DB via `docker exec sva-studio-postgres psql`: goose_db_version at 102; 68 iam.* tables incl. all critical guard tables (instances, instance_hostnames, accounts, account_roles, groups, group_roles, account_groups, organizations); 2 active seeded instances (de-musterhausen, bb-guben) with hostnames; graphile_worker schema (6 tables); roles sva_app + sva_job_worker
- App (pid 22747, `pnpm nx run sva-studio-react:serve`, env SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=local-builder, SVA_MOCK_AUTH=true, VITE_SVA_RUNTIME_PROFILE=local-builder): /health/live 200, `/` SSR renders "SVA Studio – Die gemeinsame Oberfläche für Inhalte, Module und Organisationen", /admin/users 200 (authed)
- End-to-end auth flow verified with curl: /auth/login → 302 /?auth=dev-login → POST /auth/dev-login (CSRF) → 302 + sva_dev_auth cookie → /auth/me 200 {"user":{"id":"dev:local-admin","instanceId":"de-musterhausen","roles":["system_admin"]}} → /api/v1/iam/me/context 200 (DB-backed); job worker connected; readiness db/redis/jobWorker ready
- Repo's own diagnostics execute: env:status (infra up), env:doctor:local-builder --json (19 structured checks: 9 ok), env:smoke

DEVIATIONS FOUND — ALL PROVEN PRE-EXISTING / ENVIRONMENTAL, NOT INSTALLATION DEFECTS:
1. doctor/smoke auth_login_failed + auth_me_failed: checked-in smoke contract (scripts/ops/runtime/runtime-health-smoke.ts:19,37) expects legacy `/?auth=mock-login` + user name "Builder Mock User", while app (packages/auth-runtime/src) implements `/?auth=dev-login` cookie flow with a nameless mock user. `git status`: working tree clean at 6394d99; both files' last commit is that same commit → repo-internal drift, no config or installation action can reconcile it; the actual user flow works (shown above).
2. /health/ready = 503 (keycloak_dependency_failed, tenant_auth_client_secret_missing): readiness hard-requires a live Keycloak admin (listRoles vs 127.0.0.1:8081) and provisioned tenant OIDC secrets; checked-in compose defines no keycloak/adminer/monitoring service (local Keycloak is external). In the self-contained local-builder profile this sub-check is unsatisfiable by any configuration (configured env → probe fails; unconfigured → keycloak_admin_not_configured). Matches installer's documented caveat.
3. Mainserver smoke absent (external service, not in workspace) — correctly marked optional via SVA_MAINSERVER_REQUIRED=false (doctor: mainserver_optional → skipped).
4. env:status shows app:null because the app was launched directly via nx instead of the repo's state-file runner — cosmetic reporting artifact; app process and endpoints independently confirmed running.
5. One historical "Failed to resolve @sva/plugin-generic-items" error in the serve log (pre-`pnpm build`); dist/index.js now exists and no such errors since 15:06.

CONCLUSION: every component installable in this environment is present, built, and demonstrably operational; the remaining non-passing checks are pre-existing repo contract drift and external-dependency absence, neither of which is an incomplete or broken installation.
